title: cymopterus terebinthinus
intro: Cymopterus terebinthinus, commonly known as Terebinthinine Desert Patch or Desert Patch, is a perennial herbaceous plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It belongs to the carrot family (Apiaceae) and has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe skin irritations and wounds, as well as exhibit potential therapeutic actions such as immune system support and anti-cancer activity. The bioactive constituents of Cymopterus terebinthinus include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
